Blissful Wizard Bx1 originates from the renowned Maine breeder, the Captain’s Connection, also known as CookieMaine. BLUE & CREAM
GMO x (TK x TKM10)
Blue & Cream is a potent, pungent cross that combines three classic strains into something unique and powerful. Blue & Cream is our second selection from Florida team Swamp Boys Seeds who previously bred the Breakwater crowd-pleaser, Banana Puddintain.

Blue & Cream is a cross between the fabled GMO (Chem Dog x GSC Forum Cut) and TK x TKM10 (Triangle Kush x Afghani #1). With such robust strains in its pedigree Blue & Cream is unsurprisingly a formidable strain itself. GMO's euphoric high, the potency of Triangle Kush and the intoxicating nature of the Afghani #1 meld together harmoniously and provide effects that our testers are describing as relaxing, calming, euphoric, and sleepy.

Expect Blue & Cream to provide a new and exciting olfactory experience for old-school cannabis users and newcomers alike. Traditionally off-putting aromas like moth balls and musty clothes mingle with a deep savory character and blend into a scent that is as unique as it is strangely alluring. And thanks to our phenotype's GMO-heavy disposition, buttery notes of garlic and incense can be detected during consumption. We're proud to present Blue & Cream to our patients and we hope you’re as impressed with it as we are.

145.desc:
We are committed to providing our guests with medicinally potent products that harness the remarkable healing potential of cannabis. Rick Simpson Oil (RSO) is a potent, full spectrum extract that may capture a more complete range of the beneficial compounds in cannabis than other forms of extract. Pioneered by Rick Simpson during his battle with basal cell carcinoma, RSO gained acclaim as he attributed his recovery to its use and began sharing his discovery publicly. His work helped propel global awareness and advocacy for the medicinal potential of cannabis.

We begin with the full spectrum extraction of cured premium cannabis material. We fill fine mesh bags with cannabis and load them into our extractor with food-grade ethanol. The ethanol extracts cannabinoids and terpenes in addition to other beneficial botanical compounds to capture the full spectrum profile of the plant. We filter the solution to remove any undesirable biomass or compounds and then remove all of the ethanol using a combination of vacuum and heat to distill the alcohol from the extract.

After the ethanol is completely removed, we decarboxylate the oil. This chemical reaction occurs when we apply heat to the cannabinoid acids in the extract, such as THCA or CBDA, which are the non-psychoactive precursors found in raw cannabis. In doing so, we are converting our precursor cannabinoid acids to psychoactive compounds like delta 9 THC and CBD, respectively. The decarboxylation step is crucial to activate the beneficial effects of the final product for ingestion or topical use. This final processing step produces the dark, highly pure and potent RSO.

Our filtered and decarbed full-spectrum RSO is now ready to be either added into edibles or packaged into dispensers for wide-use applications. 

RSO can be ingested or applied topically. Due to the oil’s high concentration of plant waxes and fats, it should NOT be dabbed, smoked, or vaporized. One of the most popular and effective ways to take RSO is through sublingual administration – placing it under the tongue. The mouth’s mucus membranes allow for rapid absorption of cannabinoids directly into the bloodstream.

Please note that this is a very potent product, and we highly recommend discussing dosage and administration with a budtender if you are new to RSO.

146.desc:
Pie Dough Bx1 x Grape Pie Wedding Crasher

Though pheno-hunting is always something of a lottery, we often seem to hit the jackpot with Crystal Rose Seed Co.’s genetics. Producing winners like Pie Eyed, Wave Runners, and Watermelon Otai, their complex, one-of-a-kind crosses always have us coming back for more, and Grape Crepe is no different.

Prior to the creation of Grape Crepe, Crystal Rose had the opportunity to work with MegaRaw’s brand-building, in-house selected phenotype of Pie Dough, and he crossed it with his own Pie Eyed selection to create Pie Dough Bx1. He then crossed Pie Dough Bx1 with Grape Pie Wedding Crasher, a male known for its abundant resin and grape terps, to create Grape Crepe. Our cultivation team has selected two phenotypes of Grape Crepe: one for flower and the other for solventless extracts, and we have found this cultivar to be a wild improvement on the grape category as a whole.

Opening a jar of our flower phenotype, Grape Crepe #61, launches a purple wave of grape juice and grape candy streaked with a subtle gassy note – an aroma that translates impeccably to flavor with vaporization or combustion. A balanced combination of stress-melting relaxation and uplifting euphoria is consistent with its lineage of Pie Dough, Grape Pie, Wedding Cake, and Purple Punch.

The Hawaiian-bred Skunkdog Bx1, a staple strain on the islands, is known for its ability to withstand high humidity and thrive in even the wettest climates. This powerhouse male amplifies the acrid funk of Headband and ChemD and adds hardiness to the cross. While the flowering time runs longer than average, the payoff is worth the wait - a potent, complex expression of sour, skunk, and chem exploding from every bud.

151.desc:
Ice Cream Bananaz, the focus of our 2024 Pheno Hunt, shares its roots with Strawberry Cherry Pie and Sugarloaf Pineapple, as all three strains originate from 808 Genetics’ 2021 Strawberry Runtz menu. Despite having a parent in common, Sugarloaf Pineapple, Strawberry Cherry Pie, and Ice Cream Bananaz all yield wildly different results through the diversity of their maternal genetics. In the case of Ice Cream Bananaz, the mother strain, Ice Cream Nana, was introduced to enhance and amplify the foundation of Strawberry Runtz. It’s well worth getting to know all of the phenos in our hunt, as each is a unique expression of this cross.

Phenotype #46 of Ice Cream Bananaz is closely aligned to the paternal lineage of the cross and, more specifically, to its grandfather, Runtz. Commonly known in cannabis forums as the improved Gelato, Runtz is beloved for its sweet, juicy aromas and nostalgic fruit candy flavors. Looking and tasting like sugar-frosted candy, #46’s buds check all the right Runtz boxes and may provide an uplifting and euphoric experience to match.

Peanut Butter Breath comes to us from Thug Pug Genetics, a well known breeder out of Michigan. Thug Pug has blessed the cannabis community with many tantalizing hybrids, but perhaps none more beloved than Peanut Butter Breath. 

By crossing DoSiDos with a Mendo Breath F2 male, Thug Pug created an award-winning cannabis cultivar with the ultimate “chillaxing” effects. Many have tried their hands at a DoSiDos x Mendo Breath F2 cross, and while imitation is the highest form of flattery, there is only one original Peanut Butter Breath.

A terpene profile of earth and nuttiness is counterbalanced with the classic OGKB flavor of sweet, cool kush. Ultimate relaxation is waiting around the corner of a few inhales of Peanut Butter Breath.

Effects: Calm, Euphoric, Tranquil

163.desc:
PIE DOUGH x OGKb/TK

Crystal Rose Seed Co. is a family affair out of Maine started by the DoSiDos-loving “Dosi Drew'' and his partner Amanda. Focused on breeding cultivars with high resin content and unique terpene profiles, Crystal Rose has made a name for itself in Maine and beyond.

After sparking a friendship with fellow Maine transplant and grower MegaRaw Melts, the two decided to embark on a breeding collaboration. Crystal Rose is fortunate enough to be the only breeder to this day given the opportunity to use Mega’s fabled Pie Dough female. They pollinated Pie Dough with their own powerhouse male, OGKB/TK. Bud structure in the offspring is dense, with plants tending to have a cookie/chem-type structure. The resin is extremely greasy and almost wet. Aromas and flavors range from sweet dough and gas to cherry pie and hash.

Our phenotype (as is often the case with other Pie Eyed phenos) has a balanced mix of effects, giving the user vivid cerebral clarity as well as an overall sense of relaxation. The user can expect an initial feeling of alertness and sociability, followed by a calm that soothes the stresses of a long day. Some may notice more sedative effects with a release of pressure behind the eyes and a heavying of the eyelids.

Effects: Relaxed, Calm, Tranquil
Potential Symptom Relief: Anxiety, Stress, Pain, Depression, Insomnia, Restlessness

170.desc:
Watermelon Zkittlez x Pie Eyed

Springing from the well that never seems to run dry, Watermelon Otai comes from a breeder that is likely already familiar to Breakwater regulars – “Maine-stay” Crystal Rose Seed Co. Our team’s success with Crystal Rose projects like Pie Eyed and Wave Runners has fueled our anticipation of yet another standout cross from this dynamic duo.

As fruit-dominant flavors seem to multiply exponentially with each passing year, watermelon has proven to be an elusive and coveted flavor that is difficult for breeders to capture. Pursuing this challenging prize, Crystal Rose crossed a Watermelon Zkittlez female with his Pie Eyed male. Growing similarly to its paternal lineage, our pheno displays average height and symmetrical branching. The flowers exhibit the maternal traits of the Zkittlez lineage, but with the added luster of Pie Eyed’s abundant trichome coverage. Resinous buds emit sugary-sweet watermelon and strawberry aromas, akin to a frozen tropical drink. After curing, a creamy undertone emerges to complement the candy-like layers of mellow watermelon and ripe strawberry, giving the strain its unique moniker, Watermelon Otai. (If you’re not familiar with “otai”-style drinks, you’re not alone! This Polynesian drink, originating in Tonga, combines coconut water, coconut milk, and tropical fruits such as mango, pineapple, and, almost always, watermelon). 

In Live Hash Rosin, the creaminess is exchanged for a more gassy profile which merges with those old-fashioned hard candy flavors. Delivering stress-melting effects that parallel Pie Eyed, Watermelon Otai’s tranquil, transporting relief is an on-demand tropical vacation.

J1 is a cross between two famous sativas Skunk #1 and Jack Herer and is best known for its strong uplifting clear-headed buzz that allows for extra mobility. The flowers are emerald green and frosty with a sweet aroma resembling the unmistakable Jack Herer pungency.

J1 (Haze Family) 420 Expo 1st Place 2024 - Sativa

299.desc:
Clade9’s Jelly Cake is an indica-dominant hybrid bred from Jealousy × Ice Cream Cake, offered in a premium 3.5g flower format. This cultivar pairs modern dessert genetics with a bold, gas-forward character.

Jelly Cake is a flavorful pick for cannabis enthusiasts who enjoy sweet, earthy, gas-forward cultivars with a dessert-inspired genetic background.

324.desc:
Introducing Clade9's coveted 3.5G jar of Private Reserve, a strain that stands tall as an Indica-dominant hybrid, a fusion hailing from the esteemed Bubba and OG lineages. Its buds boast a lush forest green hue, generously adorned with vibrant orange hairs, signifying its potency and visual allure. The aroma is a delightful bouquet of sweetness with robust pine undertones, offering a tantalizing flavor profile characterized by a harmonious blend of subtle sweetness and hints of sourness.

Private Reserve delivers a slow-building, potent body buzz that gradually envelops the entire being, inducing a sense of euphoria, relaxation, and a gentle surge of energy. This strain's allure lies in its ability to seamlessly alleviate aches, pains, and mental stress, making it a favorite among both seasoned enthusiasts and the medical community. Ideal for winding down, especially at night, it's a go-to remedy for insomnia, facilitating a peaceful and restful slumber. Moreover, its therapeutic benefits extend to alleviating headaches, mild to chronic pain, nausea, and depression, making Private Reserve a holistic choice for those seeking natural relief. Embrace the soothing embrace of Private Reserve, and experience the serene tranquility it brings.

325.desc: Private Reserve by Clade9 is a well-balanced strain known for its potent effects and smooth, rich flavor profile. Its aroma is a blend of earthy, citrus, and pine notes, while the flavor is smooth and herbal with a hint of sweetness. Private Reserve is great for both recreational and medicinal use, helping with stress, pain relief, and enhancing mood.

Its dense, trichome-laden buds showcase deep purples and bright greens, hinting at the terpene-packed punch within. With a smooth, flavorful smoke and an irresistible aroma of ripe berries and exotic candy, Razberry Runtz is a standout choice for fruit-forward strain lovers.

Powerful relief comes from more than cannabis alone. Before applying, clean your skin to remove oil and dirt. Apply liberally multiple times each day to hydrate irritated skin and ease areas of discomfort, such as shoulders, back, neck and feet. For best results, massage the lotion into your skin. Once absorbed, apply additional layers to achieve adequate relief. Do not apply to broken skin or open wounds.

RSO, or Rick Simpson Oil, is named after a Canadian cancer patient turned cannabis activist. RSO is sometimes referred to as a "whole plant" or "full spectrum" extract because it retains the full cannabinoid, terpene, and chlorophyll profile of the source material by using specific solvents.

RSO was originally created to be used as a topical. Rick Simpson applied this activated concentrate directly to areas of concern on his skin. Today, patients use RSO in a variety of ways, including topically, orally by itself or mixed with food, and sublingually.

1040.desc:
Ghost OG, a cut of OG Kush, is a hybrid strain loved for its balanced cerebral and body effects. Often described as simultaneously potent and non-intrusive, Ghost OG has won itself Cup awards and renown among consumers.

Despite its intimidating name, Ghost OG is actually a mellow, relaxing strain that’s great for recreational use. This is the strain to go to when you’re having a Netflix-and-Chill day at home. As an indica-dominant hybrid, Ghost OG can melt all your worries, stressors, and anxieties away and replace them with a soothing, peaceful experience. There’s nothing better than watching your favorite comedy or listening to your favorite album than with Ghost OG in the mix.

Even though the high of Ghost OG is noticeable, it’s rarely considered to be too overpowering or overwhelming. This hybrid comes with moderate THC levels that are suitable for all smoking levels. The overall experience of Ghost OG is zen, euphoric, and giggly. This hybrid produces a happy high that veers on the cerebral side in the early stages.

The second wave of Ghost OG shows its indica side. The brain and body enter a state of pure relaxation. This can help combat feelings of pain, anxiety, nausea, and inflammation. Any discomfort in the body with gradually fade away as you continue to smoke Ghost OG on the couch. It also might be a good idea to keep snacks around as this strain promotes the munchies.

1042.desc:
The GMO Cookies strain produces relaxing effects you can feel through your body while your mind retains focus. GMO Cookies is loved for its ability to relieve stress and aches without total sedation, while featuring strong aromas like diesel, coffee, and fruit. GMO Cookies is said to be the perfect choice for treating those suffering from conditions such as chronic pain insomnia, inflammation, chronic fatigue, depression, and chronic stress.

Contrary to what you might think, the GMO Cookies strain is not a genetically modified organism but a cross between Chemdawg D and a GSC (formerly Girl Scout Cookies) Forum cut. GMO Cookies is said to carry a flavor of garlic (G), mushroom (M), and onion (O) that

descends from its Chemdawg lineage. GMO Cookies is said to produce olive green buds with bits of purple and orange blanketed by a mantle of trichomes.

Known for its super pungent aroma and heavily sedative high, GMO Cookies is a favorite of indica lovers everywhere. This bud has a deliciously savory garlic flavor with a pungent spicy exhale that stays on your tongue long after your final toke. The GMO Cookies high is truly one to behold, with long-lasting effects that will have you flying high and staying there for hours on end before you fade away into a deep and peaceful sleep. You'll feel totally relaxed and lifted with a deep sense of relaxation that permeates both mind and body with heavily sedative effects.

1043.desc:
Dungeon Vault Genetics’ Grapezilla stomps onto the scene as a mighty indica born from Original Glue and Vino OG. With Myrcene leading the charge, expect a mellow, musky earthiness that gently settles the mind, while Pinene’s crisp pine notes sharpen focus and clarity. Caryophyllene adds a peppery warmth that gives each inhale a spicy kick, and Limonene brings a bright citrus twist that lifts the senses. Humulene rounds out the profile with subtle herbal undertones.

Upon first puff, sweet grape flavors surge forward, underscored by a low rumble of diesel funk inherited from its Glue parentage. Myrcene’s cozy musk weaves through that grape sweetness, while Pinene’s refreshing forest breeze cuts through the richness. Caryophyllene’s peppery spice and Limonene’s lemon-lime flair mingle on the exhale, leaving a complex aftertaste that invites another toke.

Grapezilla’s effects mirror its terpene tapestry: a gradual wave of calm that encourages deep relaxation and puts the body at ease. Pinene’s clarity helps keep the mind gently engaged, so you can dive into a good book, sink into your favorite playlist, or simply relish a quiet moment. Caryophyllene’s warm embrace and Myrcene’s soothing weight make sinking into the couch all but inevitable, yet Limonene’s lift ensures you never lose complete alertness - truly the apex of chill.

Hibernate is a potent indica strain meticulously crafted by the master breeders at Greenpoint Seeds, born from the cross of Shut Eye and Stardawg. Hibernate lives up to its name by offering deeply relaxing and soothing effects, making it an ideal choice for those seeking tranquility and restful sleep. Its terpene profile features Nerolidol 2, Limonene, Humulene, Myrcene, and Bisabolol, all contributing to its distinctive flavor and calming properties.

The flavor profile of Hibernate leans toward earthy and woody notes, complemented by hints of pine and a strong lemon peel accent. Limonene adds a citrusy zest that brightens the overall taste, while Myrcene and Humulene contribute to the strain's herbal and earthy undertones. Bisabolol introduces subtle floral nuances, enhancing the complexity of the flavor. The aroma is equally captivating, with variations that include lemon tones, cherry, rock candy, and the skunky essence characteristic of Stardawg.

Drawing from its rich genetic background, Hibernate offers a profoundly relaxing and euphoric experience. Users often report feelings of deep calmness and serenity, with a gentle wave of sleepiness that envelops both mind and body. The influence of Shut Eye provides intensely soothing effects, while Stardawg adds a touch of uplifting euphoria. This harmonious blend makes Hibernate an excellent choice for unwinding after a long day, promoting a peaceful state of mind and preparing for a restful night's sleep.

1429.desc:
Taste Notes: Sweet, Floral, Soapy Dryersheets

**A Legacy Rooted in the Heights, Cultivated in Jersey**

This drop is bigger than just flower. It’s about legacy, culture, and respect.

White Boy Kev is a Washington Heights legend. Back in the early 90’s, when the city was in the grip of the crack epidemic, Kev chose a different lane. He carved out his own path with weed because he never saw it as a drug – to him it was medicine, community, and love for the block. It was a way to uplift, not harm. Running three spots in the Heights, Kev built his name the real way: he gave the community something authentic, something that healed.

Fast-forward 35 years, and Kev's still in it for the plant – not just as a hustler, but as a grower. His pursuit now is mastery: learning, evolving, and working with cultivators who share his dedication to quality. That's why teaming up with niche. made sense – Jersey and Washington Heights are just a river apart, and this collaboration bridges that gap.

Irish Springz celebrates a genuine legend in the game. This is legacy work – paying homage to the ones who paved the way while pushing the culture forward.

Irish Springz is a hybrid that delivers a clean, nostalgic flavor experience—sweet notes that flow into delicate floral characteristics before finishing with that distinctive soapy dryer sheet aroma that gives this strain its name.

Effects might offer that balanced flow between mental clarity and physical relaxation. Many people appreciate how this one can work for different parts of the day, though everyone's experience varies. With a terpene profile led by ß-Caryophyllene and d-Limonene, this strain brings both potency and complexity to the table.

This hybrid connects with those who want flavors that tell a story and effects that keep things real. It's got that old-school authenticity with modern craft appeal—a strain that represents legacy, culture, and the bridge between street wisdom and cultivation mastery for those looking to experience something with genuine roots.

Created in collaboration with legendary boxer, entrepreneur, and advocate Mike Tyson and his new brand Tyson 2.0, Stündenglass is honored to introduce this limited edition Tyson 2.0 x Stündenglass Gravity Infuser (red and black).

A patented design backed by an extended 10-year warranty*, the Tyson 2.0 x Stündenglass Gravity Infuser comes packaged in a reusable craft box with a handle, allowing for safe storage and transportation. Super durable, futuristic in design and superb in function, the Tyson 2.0 X Stündenglass Gravity Infuser stands alone at the pinnacle of smoking devices.

1905.desc:
The VEAZY Vaporizer is the perfect blend of performance, portability, and style, built on decades of expertise in vaporization technology. Our smallest and most accessible device ever – yet unmistakably S&B.

Heating System: The Veazy uses a patented combination of convection and conduction heating, which delivers dense, flavorful vapor from dry herbs.

Portability: It is the smallest and lightest vaporizer from Storz & Bickel, weighing just 134 grams (0.3 lb), making it highly pocketable and ideal for on-the-go use.

Control: The device features an intuitive one-button control system with three preset temperature levels (Base, Booster, and Superbooster). Full temperature control (40°C - 210°C / 104°F - 410°F) and customization are available via the S&B Web App which connects via Bluetooth.

Materials & Build Quality: Constructed with medical-grade PEEK plastic and a ceramic-coated filling chamber, the Veazy is designed for durability and safe performance.

Battery & Charging: It has a built-in lithium-ion battery that charges via USB-C, reaching approximately 80% charge in 40 minutes. Note that it does not support pass-through charging, meaning it cannot be used while plugged in.
